qc/runs/hireops-live-desk-2026-10-02-r2/raw-evidence-index.json (all 10 artifact hashes and the 14 matching source hashes re-computed and matched) and qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-02-live-desk/results/live-desk.json
evidence:
REACHABILITY: every requirement is reachable from the seed, the pinned runtime or the public internet. Runtime: environment/Dockerfile:1-12 pins node:22-bookworm-slim with express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 global and NODE_PATH set; integration.md:3-5 tells the builder to use only those packages and Node built-ins; tests/Dockerfile:16-22 installs the same two packages, and tests/test.sh:104-111 launches with exactly the env (PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH) that hireops_rules.md:417-422 discloses, including the unprivileged user, the non-/app working directory and the writable copy. Sessions, password checks, exact integer arithmetic (BigInt), polling/SSE and per-user browser storage need nothing beyond Node built-ins and the browser. Seed: seed_data.json carries the 7 users (lines 40-90) matching the 7 accounts in instruction.md:19, the 3 referrers (26-39), every constant the rules cite (4-25) and reference_moment 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z (line 3) matching hireops_rules.md:59-60; operational rows are declared optional in instruction.md:17 and hireops_rules.md:92-96 and no criterion requires them (functional prompt.md:27; hro_draft_eligibility is conditional). instruction.md:17 says /assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime and to copy assets into /app, the conservative reading, so no builder is stranded. No requirement needs a wall clock: hireops_rules.md:59-67 fixes one stored moment and criteria demand no timestamps (hro_audit_text 'No particular ... timestamp'). The 15-second live update is explicitly open to polling, SSE or sockets (hireops_rules.md:533-535). Scripted golden evidence (live-desk.json, hash-verified against the frozen solution bytes, run as uid 65534 in the verifier image) shows the change-desk requirements are implementable on this runtime: pre-save figures, live out-of-date mark arriving in 807 ms, middle-member removal, field refusal, unsent entries across reload and ended session, auditor what-if, lost-response retry, restart replay. That is scripted golden evidence only; it is not a configured judge run, Oracle score or target-model build, and the index states the golden was not scripted through every Functional criterion.

SINGLE READING: I looked for a second reading in each place the brief and its notes could pull apart and found them resolved by explicit text: (a) final-overrun refusal at prepare or commit — hireops_rules.md:451 'refuses the entire preview or commit', graded tolerantly (hro_change_over_budget 'Allow refusal during prepare or, if a draft is saved, commit'); (b) what-if 'leaves nothing behind' versus persistent unsent entries — resolved at hireops_rules.md:540-542; (c) who may raise offers — the role table omits Finance but hireops_rules.md:44-45 states it; (d) validation status codes — only 401/403/409 are stated and only those are demanded (hro_change_shape 'Do not require a particular validation status within4xx'); (e) routes, ids, labels, layout — left open in instruction.md:5,15 and hireops_rules.md:53-55, 204-205, 438-439 and not demanded by the prompts; (f) polling timers versus 'nothing reads the operating system's clock' — hireops_rules.md:534-535 names polling as acceptable; (g) /assets availability — see above; (h) per-tab versus shared sessions — hro_pol_session_resume accepts either. Expected figures in D1 re-derive from the stated rules with integer half-up arithmetic (basis 98.23 + 5.01 + 1.77 = 105.01; 94.47 + 4.02 + 5.53 = 104.02; 90.22 + 6.03 + 9.78 = 106.03).

AMBIGUITIES REPORTED (the row asks for every one; I judge each bounded and not a second reasonable reading that blocks, hence Note, but none is resolved in the text, hence risk=true):
1. Overflow scope. hireops_rules.md:86-88 says 'Inputs and computed money or unit totals must fit the exact integer range 0 through 9,007,199,254,740,991 ... Use exact arithmetic through multiplication and division, then round only the named final result', while section 11 at line 449 says 'all stored money/unit results must remain exact safe integers'. The graded probe (functional judge.toml:51-57 hro_computed_overflow; hro_change_numeric lines 1005-1011, weight 1.0) is units 9007199254740991 at fair .02 / strike 0: only the intrinsic value (18,014,398,509,481,982 cents) exceeds the range, while the annualized value (4,503,599,627,370,496 cents) and the run-rate fit. I read 'computed money' as covering intrinsic value because section 2 defines it as a figure the screens must show, and the golden refuses it (solution/app/src/rules.js:62). The text does not say so in terms, and 'stored' in section 11 points the other way.
2. Retry on an operation the desk already shows as committed. instruction.md:13 asks for 'commit/retry controls' and instruction.md:3 for retry after later revisions, rescissions or a restart; hireops_rules.md:528 makes a committed change show as committed by itself within 15 seconds, and line 551-552 lets the editor start clean. The brief never says the UI must keep a retry control on an operation it already displays as committed. hro_change_retry_later says 'UI exposes a way to retry/retrieve that saved operation' and functional prompt.md B6 says 'Retry the original saved batch through its UI control and observed request'.
3. Rescission effective date later than the reference moment. Nothing in the rules forbids it, and P7(e) (functional prompt.md:49) rescinds effective 2026-09-01 against reference 2026-08-01 to reach 32 months.
4. Internal tension, ungraded: hireops_rules.md:37-38 'the auditor changes nothing at all' beside 'Other signed-in roles may also open requisitions'. Declared optional; no criterion tests Auditor requisition creation.

NOT MEASURED: no target-model build exists, so whether the whole brief (a 35 KB rules note, 152 functional criteria) is buildable inside [agent].timeout_sec = 7200 is unmeasured; that budget belongs to check 11 and I record it only as context for 'achievable'. I ran no container and no judge.
counterexample: Item 1, the only one where I can construct a plausibly conforming app that loses credit: a server that does all arithmetic in BigInt, stores the six raw terms plus annualized value and run-rate, and derives intrinsic value for display. It follows 'use exact arithmetic through multiplication and division, then round only the named final result' and section 11's 'all stored money/unit results must remain exact safe integers', accepts units 9007199254740991 at fair .02 / strike 0 because every stored figure fits, and displays the intrinsic value exactly. It scores 0 on hro_computed_overflow (0.14% of functional weight) and on the conjunctive hro_change_numeric (1.55% of functional weight), about 1.0% of total reward at the 0.6 functional share (weights summed from the frozen judge.toml: 152 criteria, total 64.404). Item 2: an app that removes the commit/retry button as soon as its live update shows the operation committed, leaving only the receipt; a strict judge could score hro_change_retry_later (1.55% of functional) or hro_pol_uncertain_commit 0 for lack of a retry control even though the operation is idempotent. Item 3: an app that refuses a rescission dated after the reference moment loses the 32-month legs of hro_signing_cap and hro_equity_cap; I do not consider that a reasonable reading because it invents a refusal the rules never state.
suggested_fix: Item 1: in hireops_rules.md section 1 name the scope once, e.g. 'computed money or unit figures, including an equity grant's intrinsic value, must fit ...', and make section 11 line 449 say 'computed' rather than 'stored'. Item 2: add one sentence to section 11 or 12 that a saved operation keeps a retry or retrieve-receipt control after it is committed. Item 3: either state that the effective date may fall after the reference moment or move P7(e) to a start date that reaches 32 months on or before 2026-08-01. These are edits to task-specific notes and prompts only; any of them changes the candidate bytes and invalidates this clearance.
